title: 건널목 개량촉진법 / queue:ADDENDUM:14839:20170726:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Government Organization Act) <Act No. 14839, July 26, 2017>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
(1) This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation: Provided, That among amendments to Acts pursuant to Article 5 of these Addenda, amendments to Acts promulgated before this Act enters into force but whose enforcement dates have not yet arrived shall enter into force on the respective enforcement dates of those Acts.

Articles 2 through 4
Omitted.

Article 5 (Amendments to Other Acts)
(1) through (205) Omitted.

(206) The Act on Promotion of Improvement of Level Crossings shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 8 (1) 1 (b), "Ministry of Government Administration and Home Affairs" shall be replaced with "Ministry of the Interior and Safety".

(207) through (382) Omitted.

Article 6
Omitted.
